retrievals.title: Amoxicillin — FDA Prescribing Information (Adverse Reactions)
retrievals.snippet: Serious and occasionally fatal hypersensitivity (anaphylactic) reactions have been reported in patients on penicillin therapy. Erythematous maculopapular rashes, erythema multiforme, and Stevens-Johnson syndrome may occur. Discontinue immediately if allergic reaction arises.

retrievals.title: Historical ADR Case Archive #0142 — Drug Hypersensitivity
retrievals.snippet: A 34-year-old female developed generalized urticaria and facial flushing 90 minutes post second dose of amoxicillin. Rapidly resolved following oral cetirizine and discontinuation of the beta-lactam.
